description: Real UI character creation with a Fighter baseline, Cipher, Sorcerer/Monk and all six Psion disciplines.
prerequisites: Disposable legal game fixture with the three current packages and their shared GUI handlers installed.
Fresh screenshots of class help, restrictions and selectors; installed class tables provide the independent identity oracle.
GemRBAcceptance.py copied into the disposable GUIScripts root; private 1280x720 display and AudioDriver=none.
instructions: Create each required actor through the real class, ability, alignment, proficiency and spell/power selectors. Include a Fighter to expose shared GUI regressions.
For each identity checkpoint, compare the engine's class row, class ID and kit/discipline with the installed tables after completing creation. Attach screenshot references in checkpoint context.

For chargen.restrictions compare both allowed and rejected race/alignment/ability choices with installed rules for each custom class. Record per-class choices, observed enabled/disabled controls or enforced ability bounds, independent expected restrictions and screenshot references; one legal Human/Lawful flow is insufficient.
For chargen.initial-spellbooks and chargen.action-bars compare known spells/powers and available buttons for each completed custom class with the installed rules.
Quit the engine normally after all actors and observations; an absent checkpoint is incomplete coverage.

Include Base Cipher and Soul Blade selection and cancellation when observing Cipher identity and restrictions; use fresh player characters. Existing-save migration and enemy packages are outside this matrix.
